component.name: Janitor
component.summary: Inspect drift across AWS secret sets

description.p: Janitor is an ephemeral desktop client for AWS Secrets Manager. It stores no secrets and no credentials of its own — it borrows them on demand over Identity Center sign-in and forgets them when it closes.
It compares the same logical secret set across environments — prod, staging, dev, possibly different accounts and regions — in a masked matrix that flags every entry as:

ul.li: Drift — present everywhere but the values differ
Gap — missing in some environments (the high-signal config hole)

description.p: Values stay masked, with a momentary per-cell reveal. Janitor is read-only by default; mutating a few entries is a deliberate, compare-and-swap write that never overwrites the whole set.

screenshot.caption: The masked drift matrix across environments

description.p: Drift matrix, guided Identity Center sign-in and discovery, and the SSM remote-.env provider.
